run_unsup_align: run the Wasserstein Procrustes script to align source and target word embeddings using argparse CLI arguments
align_embeddings: align two sets of word embeddings using the align function with mini-batch optimal transport and orthogonal projection
convex_init_mapping: compute an initial orthogonal mapping between embeddings using convex relaxation with Sinkhorn iterations
objective_alignment: evaluate the alignment quality between two embedding sets using the objective function with Sinkhorn transport
sqrt_eig_matrix: compute the square root of a matrix using SVD decomposition for embedding preprocessing
